name: Vlow AI Agent - Meta Cloud API

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  a."id" AS agent_id,
  cp."id" AS platform_id,
  a."name" AS agent_name,
  a."systemInstruction" AS system_prompt,
  a."welcomeMessage" AS greeting,
  a."welcomeImageUrl" AS welcome_image,
  a."followupConfig" AS followup_config,
  a."handoverConfig" AS handover_config,
  COALESCE(a."knowledgeBase", '') || E'\n\n' || 
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT string_agg(
        '=== ' || ks.title || ' ===' || E'\n' || ks.description || 
        CASE WHEN ks."fileUrl" IS NOT NULL 
          THEN E'\nAttached File (' || COALESCE(ks."fileName", 'file') || '): ' || ks."fileUrl"
          ELSE '' 
        END,
        E'\n\n'
      )
      FROM "KnowledgeSources" ks
      WHERE ks."agentId" = a.id
    ),
    ''
  ) AS knowledge
FROM "ConnectedPlatforms" cp
JOIN "Agents" a ON cp."agentId" = a.id
WHERE cp."sessionId" = $1;

parameters.text: ={{ $('Parse Meta Payload').isExecuted ? $('Parse Meta Payload').first().json.body : '' }} | {{ $('Finalize Context').isExecuted ? $('Finalize Context').first().json.message : '' }}

parameters.sessionKey: =meta_{{ $('Set Prod Mode').isExecuted ? $('Set Prod Mode').item.json.sessionId : 'sim' }} | {{ $('Finalize Context').isExecuted ? $('Finalize Context').item.json.sessionId : 'ctx' }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "agentId": "{{ $('Fetch Config DB').item.json.agentId || $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.agent_id }}",
  "platformId": "{{ $('Fetch Config DB').item.json.platformId || $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.platform_id }}",
  "sessionId": "{{ $('Set Prod Mode').item.json.metaSessionId }}",
  "chatId": "{{ $('Set Prod Mode').item.json.chatId }}",
  "userMessage": {{ JSON.stringify($('Set Prod Mode').item.json.message || '') }},
  "aiResponse": {{ JSON.stringify($json.text_for_wa || '') }},
  "isHandoff": "{{ $json.escalate || false }}",
  "mode": "production"
}

parameters.content: SEND RESPONSE VIA META CLOUD API
